Jayce Needs a Hug (League of Legends)

summary:
The other man gasps when Jayce wraps his arms around him in a hug, but then he folds down around him in a hug just as strong but twice as desperate.
“You're so young. You're so young,” he whispers into the top of his head, and Jayce doesn't bring attention to the tears he can feel dripping onto his hair. He knows he would hate it being pointed out himself. The hug could last one minute or ten for as much as he knows, but when the older finally draws himself away Jayce just… looks at him.
—
In which instead of going back to when he departed his timeline, Jayce is thrown much further back by accident. This will change everything, but it changes the most for our dynamic Hextech duo.
Jayce has always wanted an older brother, after all.
